shots.focal_element: ClickUp logo inside a gradient ring, orbited by eight tilted app cards (Charts, Teams, Docs, Chat, Tasks, Brain, Calendar, Forms), later replaced by an isometric ClickUp UI collage
on_screen_text: that will define the next GENERATION of software
shots.typography: Kinetic captions in a geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Plus Jakarta Sans or similar), bold, lowercase, tight tracking, words appended one at a time in sync with the VO; the key word 'GENERATION' is uppercase with a gradient fill and 'AI' is set very large in a gradient fill above a small lowercase 'age'. App-card labels are small regular-weight UI text.
shots.what_happens: Out of the zoom-through (the first 2 fps frame still shows the presenter over a large 'META CATEGORY' word from the previous shot), the white stage shows 'of' and 'apps' flanking a gradient ClickUp ring that rises from the bottom; app cards then fan out one by one around the ring while the left caption builds word by word with the VO (w240-w247), 'in the AI age' lands on the right (w248-w251), the ring wheel rotates and drifts up out of frame, and around 1:32 the frame whites out and an isometric, tilted ClickUp UI collage (Project Manager agent card, dark Mango Tech sidebar, activity and task panels) fades up and slowly drifts under 'ushers in a new era of craft and quality' (w252-w265). One detected event falls in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centered gradient-stroked ring with the logo, stagger eight rotated rounded app cards onto a circle around it (scale-up + fade, ~80 ms apart, each with a soft shadow), append left-column caption words on their VO word timestamps with the gradient-filled 'GENERATION', pop a large gradient 'AI' on the right, slowly rotate the whole wheel and translate it up, then white-flash into a 3D-tilted (rotateX/rotateZ) UI collage that fades in from white and drifts slowly diagonally.
